> [!note] In this collection
> [[collections/13993196-ai-assistants|AI Assistants]]

**Cluing Chat** gives you access to a suite of expert AI agents - **ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, Claude, and DeepSeek**.

These agents help you research faster and get precise, relevant information, complete with sources. You can easily **switch between agents** depending on your task.

## How Chat Works

1.  Go to your **Dashboard.**

2.  In the **left sidebar**, click on **Chat.**

3.  A **search field** will appear.

4.  Choose an **Agent or Model** based on what you need

5.  **Type your prompt** and hit enter.

You’ll instantly get the **most relevant insights** from both the **web** and your **Cluing workspace**.

<video src="/media/2530514411/ai-chat.mp4" aria-hidden="true" width="1910" height="982" autoplay loop muted playsinline preload="metadata" ></video>

Each answer comes with **source links** for easy **verification**. 🔗

## Give Chat More Context

AI Chat gets sharper the more context you give it. You can ground a conversation in your own research and files in a few ways:

-   **[[articles/15444365-mention-a-topic-in-ai-chat|Mention a Topic]]** - Type **@** followed by a Topic name to pull in all the snippets and comments saved there. This gives Chat a unique context based on research you've already done.

-   **[[articles/15442354-upload-documents-to-ai-chat|Upload a document]]** - Click the upload button next to the input field to attach a **PDF** or other supported file type directly into the conversation. Ask the AI to summarize it, extract key points, compare it to other content, or answer specific questions - it'll use the file as context for more accurate answers.

> [!note]
> [[articles/15442354-upload-documents-to-ai-chat|Learn more about uploading documents →]]

-   **[[articles/15190105-upload-images-in-ai-chat|Upload an image]]** - Drop an image directly into the chat to ask questions about it or have the AI analyze its content.

-   **Combining these** - your saved Topics, an uploaded document, and a clear prompt - gives Chat everything it needs to give you an answer grounded in your actual research, not just the open web.

![](/media/2530516424/image.webp)

##
Turn Chat into a Document inside Canvas

Once you've gathered insights in Chat, instantly turn them into a structured, visual document by typing **[[articles/12701026-ai-canvas|"Open in Canvas"]]**.

This lets you see the big picture immediately and **refine your output** as needed - turning a conversation into something you can actually publish, share, or build on.

![](/media/2511329323/image.webp)

> [!note]
> 💡 _You can extract knowledge from AI Chat and save it as a snippet - **[[articles/14498150-extract-knowledge-from-your-ai-chat|Learn more here]]**_

## Chat History

AI Chat History keeps all your past AI conversations in one dedicated place, so you never lose important ideas or answers.

What you can do with it:

1.  View all your previous AI chats

2.  Search to quickly find specific conversations

3.  Rename chats to keep things organized

4.  Delete conversations you no longer need

<video src="/media/2499767477/Cluing-AI-newUI.mp4" aria-hidden="true" width="1908" height="906" autoplay loop muted playsinline preload="metadata" ></video>

> [!note] In this collection
> [[collections/14011073-sharing-permissions-mention-search|Sharing, Permissions, Mention, Search]] / [[collections/14013988-mention-and-search|Mention & Search]]

With comments, you can easily mention users and bring their attention to the conversation.

## How To Mention Your Collaborators

1.  Start typing a comment

2.  In your input field, type the "**@**" followed by the name of the person you want to mention

3.  User names will automatically appear in a **dropdown menu**

4.  When you save your comment, the mentioned user will receive an **email notification** letting them know they've been tagged

> [!danger]
> 📌 If the collaborators have **Editor or Commenter** role on Cluster, they will be able to mention other users within Topics inside that cluster.

## Collaborator Suggestion List

As you type, you'll see a list of your **previously added collaborators** to choose from.

You can **quickly select** the right collaborator from the list and keep moving. This way, you will reduce mistakes like tagging the wrong person or misspelling names.

<video src="/media/2538212992/CommentCollaboratorsShort.mp4" aria-hidden="true" width="1904" height="906" autoplay loop muted playsinline preload="metadata" ></video>

## Who Can Be Mentioned In Comments?

**[[articles/11793739-mention-external-users-by-email|You can mention anyone]] - just by typing their email address.**

They’ll receive an email notification with the snippet details and a link to locate the original source.

When mentioning someone, you can also assign one of four roles: **Viewer**, **Commenter**, **Editor**, or **Mention Only**.

-   If you choose **Viewer**, **Commenter**, or **Editor**, the person will be added to the entire Topic and will have access based on the role you assign.

-   If you choose **Mention Only**, they’ll see **only that specific snippet** - not the rest of the Topic.

![](/media/1634458371/image.webp)

> [!note]
> **_[[articles/11793696-mention-collaborators-from-slack|Here's how to mention collaborators from Slack 👈🏼]]_**
